children: faces a loss of as much as $1.1B from the collapse of mortgage firm Market Financial Solutions, Bloomberg News reported, citing court-appointed administrators.

Amber Bridging and Zircon Bridging, two entities that were a part of MFS, together owe £970M to Atlas SP Partners, the credit arm of Apollo, according to documents filed with UK Companies House by administrators at insolvency firm AlixPartners.
The Apollo unit could receive between £107M and £200M back, the report noted.
The provisional figures mark one of the first attempts to quantify creditor losses on the UK-based mortgage firm, said Bloomberg.
